company_info.company_description: "Lightning Energy focuses on making solar power, batteries, EV chargers and heat pumps simple for everyone. No matter what your requirements, your solar journey should be stress free, clear and built around you.Our simplified process has been streamlined to get you the best products for the best price tailored around your requirements. Your system. Your energy. Your savings. We are your all-inclusive renewable energy partner.Investing in solar should not be confusing, stressful or frustrating. Our energy experts aim to make your experience as simple as possible from the moment you request a proposal, through to the design of the system and the installation process with our CEC (Editor:now SAA) accredited solar craftsmen.With over hundreds of five star reviews across SolarQuotes and Google, the solar journey we take you on has been tried and tested to get you the energy solutions that are the best value for the best quality.From all of the team at Lightning Energy, we welcome you to the next steps towards a new, renewable energy powered lifestyle.Quality Solar. Made Simple - Lightning Energy."

reviews.review_description: We were looking for a battery option to add to our existing solar panels whilst the Gov rebate was available. Had a quote from above vendor and used Solar Quotes to try compare apples with apples.  Apart from being based locally, the price point was better overall, the extras seem to swell the bottom line (upgraded RCD's, cement sheeting etc) a lot more with the others.Due to the high demand, we were advised early Jan was the due install date, 3 months after accepting the quote which we were OK with.  Being retired, had prepared the proposed battery site for the install including fitment and painting of the cement sheet (requirement for a weatherboard wall). As it turned out, this was beneficial, a cancellation of another job meant ours was now implemented on 06 Nov (albeit at very short notice).  Install went well, couple of little detail niggles from my perspective but nothing dramatic.  Inspector arrived a couple of days ago, did his checks and and gave it the nod, certificate arrived on the weekend so now up and running.Due to a relatively narrow location, opted to make up a barrier to shield the battery from impact - ie passing bikes, grandkids, wheelie bins, wheelbarrow etc - adapted a standard alum garden fence panel, just not sure about the colour just yetIn a nutshell - it all went well from quote (thanks Jordan) to install (thanks Caitlin) with all the background stuff happening seamlessly (thanks Lightning Energy Team)

We met at their showroom and went through the options and the most suited system. Not being tech minded the rep explained the system in plain language and how it would work.The installation was done earlier than expected due to a cancellation. The rep also came on site to check in that all was in place.After being inspected, the system has been operating , with no imports of power.Perfect!

The salesperson could not have been more helpful & had fantastic knowledge of products, comparisons, etc.The installation date was moved up 2 months, due to delay at another customer and our equipment was in stock.The installer was very knowledgeable and put in extra time to sort through some legacy issues in our switchboard, which would otherwise have caused issues at inspection.Inspection happened within a week after installation, with only 1 minor issue, which was fixed the next day.Overall, we are delighted with the whole process.

It started with Andrew in sales, he listened to what I wanted to achieve and provided a very competitive quote. They then managed to squeeze my install in to meet my schedule. I was kept informed along the way and then the install crew were great. Very easy to deal with and would definitely recommend

From start of the process to the finish I was very happy with lightening energy. The fact of the company having a show room so we could see the different range of panels & inverters before we chose which ones we wanted was good.Kale never pushed us to have a battery or get the biggest system just advised us the options. Although we had to wait 6 weeks to get it installed & didn’t receive notification the day before install the guys turned up on time & did a fantastic job completed in 1 day. I would recommend this company just because Min, Greg & the rest of the team explained what they were doing and how the system works & left the premises clean. etc.

The sales and quoting process was quick and well-organized. Blake, the project manager, was responsive and transparent throughout, promptly providing all the information I requested. He clearly explained the technical aspects of my existing solar PV setup and walked me through the options for retrofitting it with a solar battery and additional panels. Everything was communicated in simple, easy-to-understand terms — perfect for someone without a technical background.Communication was smooth and efficient, with timely responses via SMS and email. The quote I received was competitive compared to other solar battery retailers and installers.The installation process was just as well-managed. From scheduling the date and time to outlining the prerequisites ahead of the installation day, everything ran smoothly. The installation team arrived on time, conducted themselves professionally, cleaned up thoroughly afterward, and made sure I had plenty of opportunities to ask questions.Overall, I’m very satisfied with the service and would confidently recommend them to anyone considering solar upgrades.
Lightning energy were very pleasant to deal with. They kept me informed of progress. The installers were very friendly and did a good job. They were happy to explain to me how the system works.

The sales process was fast, and responsive to my variations of requests. No pre-sale site visit was conducted. I purchased during the battery stampede of 2025, so there were some expected delays in installation.  Overall the installation was fast (2 days for 11kw panels and Sigen battery).  There was limited communication around COES inspection and follow-up to get a minor defect fixed.  If you need to contact them, call on the phone, do not leave messages/emails.I would recommend them to friends looking to get a quote for solar/battery.
Excellent customer service. Fast install in 1 day on a simple roof. Very happy with the solar system and heat pump hot water I got from Lightening Energy.

The installer was very helpful and enthusiastic. I almost chose another company and let them know but then went back to Lightning Energy and they showed the same enthusiasm and gave me a price that the other company said they couldn't match for a great product. They gave me an installation date mire than a month away but slotted my job in much sooner. The installation went smoothly and looks fantastic. A minor issue with the way the site was left was resolved quickly and I am currently waiting for the final inspection and for the battery to go live.

System works great, boys were on time and did a fantastic job, as always. I have used them 4 times now for different jobs,  batteries, solar etc and they have been great to deal with. Tyler and Cain were the last boys to come out and do the work, very professional guys and hope to deal with them again soon! Thanks to the team at Lightning Solar for the great work.

I originally got on to Lightning Energy from solar quotes and my initial install was a solar + battery system. The team were professional, the install was great, and the house was left clean afterwards. Since I have had it installed it has worked without issue - since Oct23.I have now had Lightning Energy out for a second time to install 2 x PW3’s to the system, and relocate my PW2 battery to a family members system - and we again couldn’t be happier, good team, good installers, and again the area’s were left clean and tidy afterwards.Would recommend, and will be looking to use them again in the future.

Numerous problems with the installation, and absolutely no resolution for any of the problems that have surfaced since.Sigenstor battery installed, existing solar and EV charger.Asked that the charger be separate from the battery so that I could charge the car without it pulling from the battery.However if I push "boost" on the car charger the energy comes from the battery. Have emailed numerous times and no response apart from "that's odd, that shouldn't happen". No follow up at all.The gateway was bolted to a brick wall, but two of the bolts went into mortar instead. I was working next to and bumped it, and the bolts have come loose leaving it wobbling about.I asked for a rear cable entry for the gateway so the installers drilled a hole in the back then decided they couldn't do it. They were going to leave it like that but I said it should be sealed - which they did with a bit of cardboard! I don't think this is IP54 rated anymore.An ethernet cable was run from the battery to my network and it runs directly touching a 10kW cable for its full length. There is supposed to be a min. 50mm gap between these cables.The customer care line is almost never answered. When it is the request goes into a black hole.If you value your time and want to be sure you'll be looked after never deal with this company.

Once the installation is completed, you will not be able to request any support unless it is for another sales lead. When called to enquire about replacing a faulty inverter; their response was no we are not providing that support. Contact the manufacturer. That's it nothing else.

Jordan (Sales) was great at Lightning Energy, helping me through with great recommendations.Installation date was provided and delayed by 2 days due to a late stocking issue but they kept me informed throughout which was appreciated.Installation took 2 days and all my requests were taken care of (thanks Jordan the installer and Ben)Battery install is up and running now and looking forward to the lighter months to really take advantage of it.

Wanted a solar battery to add to existing solar installation for a 3P house.Sales/Quoting seem-less, appeared good value for what I was gettingNumber of meetings including a home visit to nut out details.Installation took 2 guys 1.5 days to complete. Awaiting final inspection to turn on.

The service is professional from the first step into the showroom. Kale provided exceptional service and advice. He answered all my questions about the solar battery, explained the various brands and help me to pick the most suitable system according to our situation. The quatation was seamless and detailed. Multiple quotations were provided for comparision. Kale also gave the professional assistance to pick the battery and gateway location during site visit.Installation team was professional and arrived on time. They explained the job stage-by-stage. They performed beyond expectation by managing to wire everything in the wall without cutting out the plasterboard. They also cleaned up the garage after they completed the job. App was set up and they deomtrated the platform.Kale follows up after the installation and explain the process after installation.I would definitely recommend Lightning Energy. A++++

Installation was good but post sales experience has been extremely poor.I have had a Powerwall 3 and solar panels installed. I am still waiting for the post installation documentation to be supplied to the energy supplier. I have been following this up monthly since February with little to no response. The responses I have received say they are waiting for software updates and it will be a few days. I am yet to receive a response to the email I sent on 2nd June. The company has never proactively contacted me to explain about the delays and when they will be resolved. It isn't easy to find out who to contact to resolve issues. I am extremely disappointed and frustrated with the post sales customer service.

Installation was as expected,Issues I experienced after installation include:1. 1 panel was moved from the north side to the south without consultation with myself. Understand this may have been due to lack of space however there was an East facing area where it could have been placed2. Although I confirmed that I did not want to have panels visible on the East facing closest to the back of my property I would have been fine to include them on other sections of my property that were East facing. The quote had 6 panels on the south side. As a result all of these panels are producing 60% less electricity than the north facing panels.3. I found the sales person difficult to talk to after the sales process. I wanted help on how I could get more from my existing panels but it was very difficult to have the conversation as it felt very much like he had moved on and I just need to accept how the current panels are configured.4. I am interested in getting a battery and therefore point 3 above was particularly important. At the moment I have been given no advice on what steps I can take for a battery to be worthwhile.5. I have monitored my usage for the past 3 months and my generation is 15% below what was quoted. I have been told this is normal and to expect fluctuations however via your website I was told to expect that the installer should stand behind their generation quotes and modelling.

Before you obtain provider quotes do your research on the type of system and carefully analyse your power consumption needs, otherwise you may be steered away from the ideal system for your household. The solar quote web portal was a good site to gather independent information and had a referral service. Lightening Energy was chosen for supply and install. The salesperson was knowledgeable and helped tweaked the system to get optimal capacity. I appreciated a home visit to confirm the install based so there was no additional cost. Proceeding with the install process, back-office documentation, Ausnet grid connection approval, progress status and other communication were excellent. Very happy with the installation crew. Very knowledgeable, flexible to optimise the physical install once commenced. Neat and tidy installation. System commissioning with no issues. From enquiry to final install was only 10 days. Would highly recommend Lightening Energy

With an immediate response to our sales enquiry and an onsite inspection with a drone to address our shadow concerns (onsite visit was the same day we reached out) the quoting/sales process was very quick and simple with a quote provided within a couple of days.The installation team were punctual, very professional and tidy. Plaster/paint repairs (required after an inadvertent dropped tool in the roof-space) was likewise prompt and professional and repairs were completed the week after installation. Accidents happen and it was nice that quick resolution was all part of the customer service.There were some energy company issues during grid connection resulting in significant delay to overall project completion and while this was not the installers' fault, it was the only time I felt more information / communication on status would have been helpful.  (There was only one update after the physical install in November until the installer provided the completion documents at the end of February and the power company finally completed the meter changeover at the end of April).

Great salesman quoted was here in 30 minutes. Prepared quote great price…. that’s where it ended.Quoted for battery including rebates, signed up, only to be informed “ battery not included for rebates.” Back and forth via “ texts and emails. Back and forth discounts we pay this you pay this etc etc. Then battery gained 'rebates', more back and forth via txt and emails. Arrived at agreement for price.Panels and battery installed, Monday plumber arrived “IStore will not fit through Pinch Point“ More back and forth via txt …. Salesman will investigate “ smaller unit“ more back and forth, via txt and emails.Requested on site visit, didn’t happen. Eventually suggested bringing Istore through fence, up to me to arrange contractor to to remove and refit fence. Still no on site inspection to ensure it will fit.Still waiting. Fortunately we haven’t paid for solar panels and battery.The Epic continues.

Kale from sales came & answered all my questions, which was great. Installation team were terrific & came back after hours when there was an issue with the switchboard.Post installation technical support has been dismal. A 3 week wait to be contacted after lodging a request for service support. I am still waiting, despite lodging twice online and calling twice over a 3 week period. All I am told is that they are very busy.

The sales and quoting process went really well. Using Solarquotes I felt I was starting with reputable installers.The installation went well, I was very happy with the tradespeople and the quality of work. Everything was taken care of, I just had to change my elctricity plan to one more suitable to my needs, being solar\battery and an EV.I have a SolarEdge system as it works with my complicated roof and shaded areas. There have been some teething problems with the SolarEdge application and getting all the components to work together, I don't believe this is any fault of the installer and they are assisting with resolving these.

- The sale's process was smooth with the Sale's person being nice to talk to as well as helpful with my questions over the phone and by email.- It was quite a big system (13.3kw panels and inverter) so took two days, but it went smoothly and the team were punctual and easy to work with.- Customer service was good and they helped explain the system and get used to the app i needed to use.
The instal ended up being a week earlier than originally planned which was great as I was still on leave over Xmas.

The quoting process was efficient and factual. The young woman that installed the battery system was polite, helpful pleasant and seemed very efficient. Everything went really easy and appears to be really work well. I was set up with the app data recording and shown how to use it. I am very happy with the recommendation and service through the whole process.Only complaint is on electrical inspection the main living area house lighting circuit does not work when the house relies on battery due to no power. Have just notified Lightning energy and now waiting to see how long until rectified. The back house circuit works.
Easy sales/quotation process and good installation.Good education of how the system works.

Whole process was great start to finish. The quote and information process with Trent was clear and easy to understand. Turnaround time on install was great and the boys on the day did a great job and explained things as they went. Have waited years to make a Solar decision and not preconceived call backs from countless companies. This process from the moment I clicked SolarQuotes was so easy I regret not finding it sooner
Very informative company. Installation was timely. Installers friendly and patient.
Excellent service. Everything was well explained. Installation was very quick and clean with minimal disruption. System working as expected.

Process was good until ... apparently the new model Tesla battery we chose hasn't yet received all the necessary approvals. So our installation is on hold.It would have been helpful to have known this was a possibility before we made our battery choice, as we may have chosen differently. Perhaps everybody has been taken by surprise.

The installation was completed very quickly, Installer showed me how to read app and operate inverter if required to shut down.  Grid connection was fast. after that had to wait for Energy Australia to start measuring Kw to the grid.  This required reprogramming of smart meter.  Overall quick process, very happy with job.

I recently purchased a heat pump hot water system and solar panels from Lightning Energy. It was great to be able to go to a showroom and see the products. The sales team were very helpful - knew the products and what would be best for my needs and budget. Installation was done very quickly with everything very straightforward including all the paperwork and rebate application process. Very happy with my set up and can already see my energy bill going down.

The sales process was very slick, they were able to provide a quick install date, arrange rebates and supply a unit at a competitive price. The electrician that came to do the install was polite, helpful, he did a very good job, it was neat and he tidied up after himself. He spoke respectfully to my wife and was keen to do a good job. The plumber was very different, he started working without telling us he was onsite. The install was not level, which is in breach of warranty and the insulation and fittings he used were old and poorly applied, he cracked the slab the hot water system was on and left the job without checking with us and hoped we would not notice. He came back two more times before the installation was correct. Trying to get customer service from Lighting Energy was difficult, they did not want to know about any problems and it took weeks, lots of txt messages and phone calls to lightning energy to get this sorted out. I would not use them again and would not recommend them to anyone. A true test of a companies' integrity is how they behave when things to go bad, they failed.

Wow, what a great experience! I chose Lightning Energy for the install purely because they were a little cheaper than the other quotes I received. They also suggested Enphase microinverters as a good option for us and are a gold rated installer of those systems. Every step of the way was so efficient, from the provision of quotes, promptly answering our questions as they arose, right through to install and commissioning - which was all done really quickly! The install team were friendly, on time, knew their stuff and ultimately did a great job. The Lightning admin team organised the grid connection / inspection after install and we were up and running in no time. Have since recommended Lightning to a couple of other friends in the market for Solar - they were great to deal with and are a well oiled machine!

Pre-sales support was great. Kale spent a lot of time going through my wants and needs, and we landed on a system that I was very happy to proceed with.The installers were prompt and professional, and did a great job taking down the old panels and putting the new ones in. Battery, inverter and EV charger installation were also nicely done, with a very neat install, and no mess left behind. An issue with the backup circuit was resolved the next day, and the system was great.One issue I'm having trouble with, was that part of system design was to put optimisers on the north facing panels (as they are subject to shade in the winter). However, once winter came, and the panels started experiencing shade, it was clear that they weren't optimising.I initially reached out in May, but am still waiting on a resolution. Have needed to engage with SolarQuotes to get Lightning Energy to respond, but things are still moving very slowly.Will happily update the review once issues are resolved.

Lightning were the quickest to respond and were only one of two that actually contacted us and followed up.  Had 31 panels and a Tesla Powerwall 3 installed. The installation took place over 2 days, the team (and there were a few of them) were polite, professional and got the job done with a minimum of fuss.  Really have a nothing but praise for the quality of the work. Cleaned up really well and showed me how to use the associated app.However now the job is done I have system that isn't activated and the admin side is letting them down, I have asked a number of questions with no response re the next steps of which is not clear to me how to have the system activated - it looks good but useless till i can actually use it and there were a few hiccups prior to installation.  ( hence the 4 stars) if the admin side is not supporting the fantastic installation side to the same level it does leave a bit of a slight feeling of being abandoned.

Sales and quoting process did not include any excess flair, everything was listed and quoted succinctly easy to understand. Also provided free site inspection one day after request and easily answered any questions.Installation was done by Caitlin and the job is done professionally. Installation went smoothly, no gotchas or anything unexpected, everything went exactly as described during the quotation process. Caitlin was polite, minimal disturbance, arrived on time and cleaned up the worksites after finish installation.After installation Caitlin showed me how to operate the battery, Tesla app with patience and clarity. Every step along the way lightning energy team reached out and let me know what's happening and answer any questions I had.

The team from Lightning energy were very professional and knowledgeable.  From the initial sales contact with Trent, who has also been an installer. Right through to the installation team lead by Ryan who were punctual and did a great panel fit out. They were very helpful with any questions I had. They were also employees of Lightning Energy, not subbies. Fantastic job, I would highly recommend.

So happy with Lightning Energy, from the quoting and explanation of the system through to the installation team.They were polite, amazing and felt like I had family over doing work at the house, not just people.Can not thank the team enough!

Sales, system sizing and layout Ok. No site inspection, all done by phone, email and photos. From there website and socials I expected there staff to do the job but a sub contractor arrived. He had no materials to mount the Tesla battery, Gateway and Enphase box so scrounged a old piece of pine board from my shed. Cut roughly to uneven lengths and screwed to my steel shed wall rails. They drilled through the roof into the lighting wiring (waited 2 weeks for that to be fixed). The gateway box is so close to the other hardware it is very tricky to open. The bollards ( like most of the job) are unevenly placed. They somehow wired the grounds from the inverters to active and they all had to be replaced (I now have doubts about the longevity of the panels). Had a heat pump hot water installed the same day, plumber finished at 10 am. HWS was not wired and on until 5pm so no hot water that night. Once the system was working (2 weeks after initial install) I was given a quick set up on the Tesla app. The rest I am working out for myself. With a total of around $30k in invoices (before subsidies) I expected better.
The process very goodThe install was fantasticCustomer service was top notchNot yet connected to the grid but they are keeping us informed

My quote included removal of 6 panels and upgrading the switch board.They adjusted the quote up before it expired which they informed me of, and I accepted the updated quote.The systen is sheduled to be installed in 10 days.

Found the process with the representative easy and informed.  There process to determine best set up and use of visuals and illustrations was very effective.  The actual installation was also no fuss and work was done with minimal interruption as I often work from home.

Sales and quoting was done well with Lightening Energy providing a better price for the same system as quoted by competitors.Installers were quick and professional. Clean up was fair. Some issues with installation were picked up from a 3rd party inspector which I engaged as soon as installation was complete. I am still working with Lightening Energy to get these rectified.Customer service is a bit slow as we are still working on getting installation issues rectified, and the battery settings took some time for them to adjust. The team is polite and professional, they recognise when some things have slipped through the gaps and I appreciate that. I would still recommend their services.

friendly and helpful during the design phase. Installation team were very nice and professional. I am very happy with the quality of the install. The only negative point (very small) is that the final installation is slightly different from the design config but I doubt it will affect the final performance at all.

After several phone calls and emails with questions, a site visit where they even brought a panel sample to show me, a fourth quote being generated with a variation of options I ultimately chose Lightning Energy for the components they proposed for my house.    They even helped me sort out the address incorrectly recorded with the energy wholesaler.     Their customer service is fantastic.Then installation was arranged and I even received a text with an image of all the panels and necessary bits and pieces being gathered up with my name on them.    On the days of installation they worked hard ensuring the panels were in alignment.   They cleamed up after themselves and left my premises neat and tidy.

The sales and quoting process was professional and well done with all the necessary facts and information laid out clearly . The installation was done exactly as explained by the sales team with no unexpected problems or issues .The customer service was very good and all the workers were polite and friendly . The worksite was left clean and tidy . The electrician explained the operation of the inverter at the completion of the work . We waited only 5 days before the inspector came and did the connection . About 2 weeks now since installation and all going well - even with the cloudy conditions in Melbourne .

Lightning Energy are a fantastic installer that i reccommend contacting if you are thinking of getting solar installed.The sales representative I co-ordinated the install with was fantastic and together we came up with a solar solution that fit into my price range and had the option to expand in the future for the unique existing grid connection that my property has.The electrical installer that installed the system was very professional. He did an excellent job installing the system. All of the equipment was installed very neatly.Any issues that I identified post installation, they were able to rectify very quickly without an additonal cost.Lighting Energy organised everything with our grid connection and it went very smoothly for us. We got regular updates on how everything was progressing regarding the grid connection

Professional and timely response to my quote request. Provided a number of detailed system options, for my review and selection. Once my order was placed, quickly scheduled works, and in fact was able to bring the installation forward, as their schedule allowed.Particularly impressed with their installation team, who performed beyond expectations on my very challenging site.Would highly recommend.
It was a vibe but we got there in the end. These guys aren't the cheapest but are well informed, good service, and I believe they'll be around for awhile so if I have issues they'll get fixed.

Sales quoting process was good. the sales rep picked up quickly, that i wanted a system of good quality and that could be expanded in the future. Unfortunately he did not visit the site.The Installation team arrived on time and were very efficient. I was then informed by the electrician that the front row of panels would shade the back row and did i want to cancel the installation or he could drop the front row down and we would end up with a system that was not quite as efficient as predicted.i decided on the spot to go with the lower front row.The system has been running now for 9 days and i contacted AGL to see what plan would best suit my usage.To my surprise they had no record of a solar system at my address and i should contact my installer which i did yesterday. They said we will get back to me.I also rang United Energy and was informed that the meter would have to be changed and that there is no Electricity that the system is producing going back into the grid.The spokesman at United energy said the application should have been made when i paid the deposit.As you can see I am not very happy with the Company..Alwyn Abraham

The salesperson was efficient, very knowledgeable and helpful. I contracted originally in November and it took until last week 24/25 of January for the team to arrive. They too were friendly and efficient,  hardworking despite the heat and the job was done in about 12-14 hours. They left no mess. They set me up with Enphase, but I had deleted a message from Tesla, so I am waiting for a post installation consultant to contact me. Too, I am waiting for a final electrical inspection. I suppose everything is working but I have no way of telling. I am excited to be joining the modern world, but did I jump prematurely? I continue to read about improvements in battery technology etc, but everything is changing.

I had to follow up when installation was going to be.  The installers did a great job and very helpful even after installation.Tried twice to get sales to call back about extending batteries, heat pump hot water service and a large system for my factory.  Rang and left messages, no one called back so I will go elsewhere.Disappointed

Everything went well with minimal chasing up from the quoting to the grid connection and all in between.It ended up costing a bit more than expected but there were several factors that affected this such as a top spec system (micro-inverters), double storey, multiple roof pitches and tiles. So all in we are very happy with the system and service.

Like many, I’ve spent a lot of time researching solar systems that are suitable for me. I found Lightning Energy to be more a partner on my solar journey, rather than a product provider.The service consultant I have been assigned is an installer and able to field my queries in real time. Wanting to understand my objective by having solar rather than selling me a product.I found Lighting Energy’s website to be easy to navigate, and really liked the platform/format they use to provide quotes/system details.My installation has yet to commence, but my experience thus far has been impressive. This coming from a guy, that at times, is hard to please ?.

Having installed my solar system and Tesla battery previously, I knew they would be very competitive when quoting for the second Tesla battery.  Their price was the best by several hundred dollars.  This was all done on line and was quick and easy to process.Speaking to the sales team representative to schedule the installation date was again quick and easy.The installation team arrived on time and were only to happy to answer my many questions about how they connected the second Tesla battery to the existing one.The grid connection application was initiated by the installation team. To my surprise I had a phone call from the inspector the next day. He was in my area doing inspections and would like to do mine. So l was turned on to the grid within  a day.With the two batteries we are now using off the grid solar for 100% of our daily energy needs. Any excess power is still being feed back into the grid.
Fast and Professional service from Solar Quotes, provided some great competitive companies to help with my decision in getting a battery.

We had a good experience with the sales and installation teams and I am very satisfied with the neatness of the installation, and in how the system is performing now that it’s up and running. There was a slight hiccup with the install that delayed commissioning, but this was diagnosed by their experienced service technician around a week later and then rectified the same day.

Jordan (sales) was outstanding in answering all of our questions. He was quick to reply to email and friendly on the phone.On our end It took us a long time to sign up to the install of the 6.6kw system and Tesla battery - but once we were ready to go Jordan was able to arrange everything for us.My only call-out was that I wasn’t able to easily get onto the admin team to get an update - however I was able to call/email Jordan who was able to provide updates - and basically he became my point of contact throughout the process - not sure it was his job, but he made sure everything was sorted and was able to provide details/dates that I was after.The installation team were friendly, and professional, turned up on time, talked me through the setup - helped me setup all the apps etc, did a great job - and post install the are was left clean and tidy.When I had a question the following day, I called the office and one of the techs called me back to arrange to come to the property to update something for me.The system & battery are performing as expected.I would be very happy to recommend this company for future Solar/battery installs.

From the very first contact requesting a quote to the final switching on of the solar system this company were great to deal with. All staff and contractors were very professional, turned up on time and did a great job. I would be very happy to recommend this company to anyone considering installing solar on their premises

Living in the Ranges, we needed a system that would not only reduce our power bills but provide power night and day during frequent outages. SolarQuotes provided our details to three companies. Two companies called back within the week, to begin the design process. The third company sent us a robot email to say someone would call soon, we did not hear from them. We sourced two other quotes ourselves, and we had already researched and priced a suitable system online.The two quotes we sourced ourselves did not really understand the importance of a larger system with microinverters and a battery, instead trying to sell us the products they stocked.Of the two installers forwarded by SolarQuotes, both listened to our needs and designed a suitable system. That was untrue, but I did not complain, as I was elated to finally have solar in, but for a few elements:-the CT clamp was not properly set in the inverter settings (for a year I got no stats on self-consumption)-the weather covers for the roof isolators have been installed attached to the panels on the northern aspect, partially obscuring the first panels, especially in winter (entire day shading)-most importantly, during the installation, a problem became apparent with the ATS (which might be related to how it has been wired, with power backfeeding to the inverter EPS circuit during a power fault); the installer told me it might have been a faulty ATS and a replacement was being sent, but they never rectified the problem.I communicated all of these to Lightning Solar multiple times, but they never rectified the problems.COVID and all, I was overall sailing happily with solar for almost a year, when the first major problem occurred.19/06/22 the battery stopped charging. Discovered the problem a couple days later and notified Lightning Solar the 21/06/22, to which they replied that they would "raise it with their technical team".About a week later I contacted Growatt, hoping for a quick remote fix from them. I copied Lightning Solar in all the email conversations with Growatt. Growatt asked for Lightning Solar to step in and verify the installation, with no response. Growatt later ascertained that the inverter is faulty (maybe due to the never-rectified problem with the ATS and EPS circuit?). During the troubleshooting, they fixed the config to allow me to see self-consumption stats (at least a small win).Lightning solar has been contacted multiple times, through all the email contacts I had for the company, and never bothered to reply.In my last call to them, I made clear that I was chasing them for a month and that they should provide me with an ETA. They replied that they would have called me back yesterday. They decided to not even call me back after providing a date.
